boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Ohio State library environments, from reservable group rooms to subject-focused collections and research spaces.

cards.title: Thompson Library
cards.subtitle: 1858 Neil Avenue Mall
cards.notes: Set up in the main library and use its computers, wireless service, printing, or research help; check the posted calendar before you go.
cards.short_summary: A large campus library with study areas, computers, printing, and research support.
cards.evidence_claim: Thompson Library provides study spaces, more than 230 computers, wireless service throughout the building, and printing.
cards.source_title: Thompson Library | Ohio State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Posted hours vary by day; consult the library page or calendar before visiting.

cards.title: Thompson Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Thompson Library, second and third floors
cards.notes: Bring a small group and reserve through the Ohio State Mobile App, or use an unreserved time; groups have priority over individual users.
cards.short_summary: Reservable small-group rooms with walk-in use when unscheduled.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio State students, faculty, and staff can reserve Thompson group study rooms for up to four hours; unscheduled times allow walk-in use, with groups prioritized.
cards.source_title: Group Study Rooms for Ohio State Students, Faculty and Staff | Ohio State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: For small-group work only. Reserve in the Ohio State Mobile App; rooms can be requested the same day through one week ahead, subject to availability.

cards.title: 18th Avenue Library
cards.subtitle: 175 West 18th Avenue
cards.notes: Use the tables, study pods, computers, printing, or group-room reservations; bring a current BuckID if studying during restricted overnight hours.
cards.short_summary: Science and engineering library with visible study pods and extended building access.
cards.evidence_claim: 18th Avenue Library offers public-use computers, printing, group study room reservations, student study tables and study pods; current OSU ID is required from midnight to 7 a.m. on weekdays.
cards.source_title: 18th Avenue Library | Ohio State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: The page lists 24-hour Monday–Friday access during the regular schedule, with a current OSU ID required 12 a.m.–7 a.m.; hours may change for breaks and holidays.

cards.title: Research Commons
cards.subtitle: Third floor, 18th Avenue Library
cards.notes: Graduate students, postdocs, and faculty can use this research-focused public space and ask about collaborative rooms, data visualization, and consultations.
cards.short_summary: A research-centered space with collaborative rooms and specialist support.
cards.evidence_claim: The Research Commons serves graduate students, faculty, and postdoctoral researchers and offers rooms for collaborative projects, videoconferencing, and data visualization.
cards.source_title: Research Commons | Ohio State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on the third floor of 18th Avenue Library. The public space is described for graduate students, postdocs, and faculty; posted hours are weekdays 9 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Architecture Library
cards.subtitle: 400A Knowlton Hall, 275 West Woodruff Avenue
cards.notes: Choose a carrel, red chair, or window-facing table, then use the public computers or printers for architecture, planning, and design work.
cards.short_summary: A Knowlton Hall library with carrels, window-facing seating, and design collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Architecture Library describes a comfortable study and research setting and shows first-floor carrels, seating, a second-floor study room, and window-facing study spaces.
cards.source_title: Architecture Library | Ohio State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in Knowlton Hall. Regular posted service hours are weekdays 10 a.m.–2 p.m.; verify the library calendar for changes.

cards.title: Fine Arts Library
cards.subtitle: 040L Wexner Center for the Arts, 1871 North High Street
cards.notes: Work among art bookshelves or at a table, and use the public computers, printers, or flat-bed scanners when your project needs visual-source support.
cards.short_summary: An art-focused library with tables, soft seating, scanners, and study space open to all.
cards.evidence_claim: Fine Arts Library says all are welcome to use its materials and study spaces and provides public computers, printing, and two flat-bed scanners.
cards.source_title: Fine Arts Library | Ohio State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located within the Wexner Center for the Arts. Posted regular hours are weekdays 10 a.m.–2 p.m.; confirm before traveling.

cards.title: Geology Library
cards.subtitle: 180 Orton Hall, 155 South Oval Mall
cards.notes: Use a table, carrel, soft seat, or group option, then consult the library’s geologic and topographic maps when they fit your research.
cards.short_summary: An Orton Hall study environment with maps, globes, fossils, and several seating formats.
cards.evidence_claim: Geology Library offers students tables and carrels, soft seating, and group options, alongside more than 200,000 geologic and topographic maps.
cards.source_title: Geology Library Celebrates 100 Years in its Orton Hall Home | Ohio State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located in Orton Hall. The library location page lists regular weekday hours of 10 a.m.–2 p.m.; verify current hours before visiting.

cards.title: Food, Agricultural & Environmental Sciences Library
cards.subtitle: Room 045, Agricultural Administration Building
cards.notes: Reserve a group room when working with classmates, or use the public computers, printing, chargers, and calculators for focused coursework.
cards.short_summary: A ground-floor subject library with group rooms and practical study equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: The FAES Library provides group study rooms, public-use computers, printing, charger cords, and calculators for checkout.
cards.source_title: Food, Agricultural & Environmental Sciences Library | Ohio State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Room 045 is on the ground floor of the Agricultural Administration Building. Posted regular hours are weekdays 10 a.m.–2 p.m.; check for changes.

cards.title: Music & Dance Library
cards.subtitle: 210-A, second floor of 18th Avenue Library
cards.notes: Bring score or recording research to the second floor and use the Music & Dance collection; ask the service desk about access to reserves.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor library for music and dance materials, including recordings and scores.
cards.evidence_claim: Music & Dance Library is on the second floor of 18th Avenue Library and holds scores, books, periodicals, sound recordings, and video recordings; its facilities are open to Ohio State affiliates and the public.
cards.source_title: Music & Dance Library | Ohio State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: The location page says the library is open 24 hours, while service-desk and reserves access follow posted hours; verify current building access before arrival.

cards.title: Health Sciences Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Third floor, Prior Hall, 376 West 10th Avenue
cards.notes: Reserve a third-floor room online or at the front desk for quiet work with up to five people; use the monitor, whiteboard, and power outlets.
cards.short_summary: Third-floor quiet study rooms with whiteboards and monitor connectivity.
cards.evidence_claim: Health Sciences Library study rooms accommodate up to five people, have whiteboards and mostly 43-inch HDMI monitors, and can be reserved for two hours up to three days ahead.
cards.access_notes: Reserve online or through the front desk during normal operating hours. Rooms are on the third floor; student reservations receive first priority.
